Order Re: Vexatious Litigant
 
1 || Appearing as attorney for Alaron Trading Corporation was Jose H. Garcia of the Law Office of
2|| Martinez & Martinez. There was no appearance for Plaintiff Ralph Scott.
3 Having considered the moving papers, and satisfactory proof having been made, and
4| good cause appearing, IT IS ORDERED that:
5 1. The Motion is GRANTED.
6 2. Ralph Scott is hereby declared a vexatious litigant.
7 3, Ralph Scott shall not file any further actions in this Court without first seeking leave
8 from the Presiding Judge of this Court.
9 4. The Clerk of the Court is to transmit a copy of this Order to the Judicial Council of
10 California, Administrative Office of the Courts, for the purpose of including Ralph
11 Scott on its Vexatious Litigant List.
